thread:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty -> PROD-API-503 triggered at 2025-11-02 03:12 UTC. P1. Error spike on /v1/generate. Pager: @meera :phone:
meera: picking this up. looking at grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.example/d/prod/requests-overview?from=now-30m :eyes:
alex: I can check model routing and recent deploys, ping if you want me to rollback a canary
meera: quick notes: 5xx rate jumped from 0.4% -> 5.6% around 03:05 UTC. CPU/memory on nodes look fine, saw a bunch of "upstream connect error or disconnect" in envoy logs. redis/memcache latency elevated too.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary/generation-service v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 completed at 2025-11-02 03:05 UTC on dedicated-pool-canary :information_source:
alex: that lines up. canary had a new timeout change in svc client. I'll tail the canary logs and revert if needed.
tomas: while alex checks that, we should add a temporary routing fallback to the previous model variant to reduce customer impact. command: ```redwoodctl route update --service generation --fallback-variant v3.2.0```
meera: applied fallback routing at 03:20 UTC. error rate dropped to ~1.2% but alerts still noisy (many instances firing the same alert).
jordan: looks like alert noise is the problem too. current prometheus rule fires on any host > 1% 5xx for 1m which is too sensitive during deploy churn. propose: require sustained cluster-wide rate > 2% for 5m OR add per-deploy suppression window. example rule snippet: ```- alert: High5xxRate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[5m])) > 0.02
  for: 5m
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained 5xx rate > 2% over 5m"
    runbook: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/INF/Runbooks#High5xxRate
```
meera: created ticket RDW-2345 to track alert tuning and dashboard work -> https://go.redwood.example/issue/RDW-2345 (assigned to tomas). Added short notes about suppression during rolling deploys.
tomas: I'll own the alert change + dashboard update. Plan: change rule like jordan suggested, add an annotation linking the runbook, and add a panel that breaks down errors by model_variant and by region. Will push changes to monitoring repo and add PR link in the ticket.
meera: runbook update plan: add a new subsection "Alert tuning during deploys" with: 1) who owns the tuning (oncall team), 2) how to suppress (link to deploy windows), 3) when to page (customer-impact threshold), 4) example Prometheus rule + rollback command. I'll add an owner field: oncall-sre@redwood and put a pointer to the monitoring PR. Draft link: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/INF/Runbooks#AlertTuningDuringDeploys
alex: for the rollback command I ran a quick revert on canary and verified v3.2.0 handles the traffic fine. command used: ```redwoodctl deploy rollback --service generation --to v3.2.0 --pool dedicated-pool-canary```
sara: i'm taking night oncall in ~20m. please handoff anything outstanding. can you post a list of active alerts and the mitigations you applied?
meera: active alerts: High5xxRate (cluster) - firing, HighEnvoyUpstreamErrors - partially firing, RedisLatencyHigh - resolved. Mitigations: fallback to v3.2.0 (routing change), scaled dedicated pool +2 nodes, reverted canary. Links: dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/incident-1751234567, ticket -> https://go.redwood.example/issue/RDW-2345
sara: ack. i'll watch for the next hour and will page if error rate > 2.5% sustained for 10m.
jordan: quick note for post-incident: we should annotate the alert with "suppress_during=deploy" and add an owners[] tag so it's clear who to message. also add metric labels for model_variant so triage is faster.
meera: customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reported latency spikes (~20s) for a 15 minute window. CS notified, tickets created and linked in RDW-2345. No data exfiltration.
tomas: once PR for alert rule is up I'll add runbook link in the alert annotations and ping oncall channel for review.
meera: handing off to @sara for monitoring. I'll run the postmortem doc tomorrow morning and attach timeline + alert changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy rollback v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 executed at 03:37 UTC by alex :white_check_mark:
meera: closing thread, will reopen if anything flares. post-incident action items: RDW-2345 (alert tuning), RDW-2346 (runbook update), RDW-2347 (dashboard panel).
